visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men stand in a covered outdoor walkway with white pillars and green accents. The man in the foreground wears a black and white horizontal striped polo shirt, while the man behind him wears a cream t-shirt with a blue plaid sweater draped over his shoulders. (2) A hand from off-camera offers a single pack of candy, which the man in the striped shirt takes and begins to pull, revealing an impossibly long strip of interconnected candy packs. The man in the cream t-shirt reacts with wide eyes and open-mouthed surprise, gesturing toward the expanding strip. (3) The man in the cream t-shirt moves to the foreground and speaks directly to the camera with animated hand gestures and smiles. The man in the striped shirt remains in the background, continuously pulling the long candy chain which now extends several meters. (4) The scene transitions to close-up shots of various colorful Hi-Chew boxes (grape, strawberry, yogurt flavors) stacked on a surface, followed by a digital interface overlay showing a path-based mobile game with cartoon characters. (5) The final scene shows the man in the striped shirt standing outside a large white building, completely wrapped in the long candy chain as if it were a scarf, while the other man waves to the camera.
